tools.name: list_pilgrimages
tools.title: List pilgrimages
tools.description: List all published pilgrimage trips with dates, destinations, prices, and status. Each trip has bilingual (RU/RO) titles and descriptions.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.title: List destinations
tools.description: List all published pilgrimage destinations (countries/regions) with bilingual (RU/RO) titles, short descriptions, duration, and starting price.

tools.name: get_destination
tools.title: Get destination details
tools.description: Get full details for one pilgrimage destination by its slug, including intro text, program days, shrines, FAQ, and inclusions. Use list_destinations first to find valid slugs.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.title: List blog posts
tools.description: List all published blog posts with bilingual (RU/RO) titles, excerpts, and publish dates. Use get_blog_post to fetch the full body.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.title: Get blog post
tools.description: Get the full body of a published blog post by slug, in both Russian and Romanian. Use list_blog_posts to find valid slugs.
